[[File:Hover_cannon_TPM.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A hover cannon.]]
'''Hover cannons''' were heavily armed, floating [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] powerful enough to reach the [[Senate Landing Platform]]s of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A number of them were used by the [[Coruscant mercenary|Coruscant mercenaries]] to [[Skirmish at Coruscant|attack]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] as they traveled to [[500 Republica/Legends|500 Republica]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Hover cannons appear in [[1999]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]. The mission in which they appear completely contradicts the scene in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. In the film, Amidala goes straight to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] without incident.
